photos.view: Garden-side long south elevation, viewed through the garden toward the north; lower and central parts substantially obscured by trees.
features: Long brown-brick slab with white window surrounds and pale vertical strips, regular rectangular multi-pane windows.
Two repeated polygonal projecting window stacks are visible on either side of the center; these are facade-scale bay windows, not proof of whole-footprint north projections.
A pale uppermost facade band and small stepped central parapet/crown are visible, with a higher block set behind.
Large trees, entrance canopy and low garden buildings occupy the foreground; they are not automatically part of this historic slab.
limits: No direct roof plan or complete north/east elevation.
Tree cover prevents reliable counting of all floors, lower openings and entrance arrangement.
Photograph predates the secondary source’s stated 2009 refurbishment; it establishes this recorded appearance, not every present detail.

photos.author: N509FZ
photos.view: Northwest Changle Road / Maoming South Road street corner, looking toward the facade returns and north-side recess. The private filename garden2019 is only a cache name; this is not the garden elevation.
features: Brown brick with white stepped window surrounds; broad multi-pane windows alternate with narrower central openings.
A strongly recessed wall meets tall projecting parts; the photograph confirms depth and a concave street-side form rather than a single flat frontage.
At the right, narrow vertical pale bands rise through the facade; at the left, broader windows and a narrower central strip form a different bay rhythm.
Pale top cornices/parapets, upper setbacks, small rooftop chimney/vent forms and isolated railings are visible; not a pitched green pyramidal crown.
Light-colored low rounded corner frontage has tall narrow multi-pane openings and a shallow decorated top band; the lower right wall has stone-like piers and commercial glazing.
limits: This oblique view does not reveal the complete north/east outline or both north projections in plan.
Top surfaces, roof equipment locations/depths and the garden facade are not fully visible.
Tree and wires hide some lower openings; shop lettering is transient.

cross_image_findings: 2006 garden and2019 northwest street images show matching brown brick/pale window framing and different facades of the Cathay historic slab.
Garden-side polygonal window stacks differ from the deeper northern footprint projections; they must not be conflated.
2019 and undated northwest image show the same broad stepped/recessed form; historical roof shelter and ground floor are not a current design prescription.
Distant historical context distinguishes flat-topped Cathay at left rear from Grosvenor’s tiered central crown.
No image establishes a full measured perimeter, complete hidden elevations or a roof plan.

coverage.south_garden_facade: Observed in2006 with heavy lower/central tree occlusion.
coverage.northwest_corner_and_west_return: Observed in2019 and corroborated by undated historical image.
coverage.north_recess: Partially observed obliquely; complete north outline and both projections not proven from image alone.
coverage.roof_surfaces_and_courtyard_plan: Not verified; selected parapets/setbacks and small equipment silhouettes visible only.

limited_search.result: Actually inspected category file links; all four listed photos were downloaded and viewed. They provide garden, northwest street, same-side historical and distant context coverage, not a complete roof or east boundary survey.

scope_decision.subject: Cathay Mansions / 华懋公寓 = 锦江饭店北楼 / 锦北楼; it is a separate historic building from Cathay Hotel / 华懋饭店 / 和平饭店北楼 and from Grosvenor House / 峻岭公寓 / 锦江饭店中楼.
scope_decision.recommended_modeled_extent: Only the Cathay historic principal building. Separately mapped garden buildings, small auditorium, Grosvenor House, other Jinjiang hotel blocks, New Jinjiang Hotel and Peace Hotel are excluded.

address_policy.resolution: Retain the fixed inventory address as provenance; publish the discrepancy instead of silently replacing the source. Identity is resolved by names, road junction, photos and separately reviewed map footprint; exact current/historic door-number correspondence remains unverified.

excluded: Cathay Hotel / Peace Hotel north building on the Bund
Grosvenor House / 峻岭公寓 / 锦江中楼
Small auditorium between north and middle buildings
Other compound/garden blocks and New Jinjiang Hotel
scope_decision.map_authority: Photo/documentary identity only. Exact global source membership, geographic orientation and outline must be decided in the separate map-scope review.
scope_decision.photo_coverage: Two complementary contemporary view families: garden south (2006) and northwest street corner (2019), plus same-side historic and distant context.

not_proven: 57 m / 14 storeys versus 65 m / 13 storeys, and the endpoint/original grade of both heights.
1925 start and 1928 investment occur in separate official paragraphs; this review does not invent an explanation.
Complete roof plan, east boundary elevation, both northern projections in plan, roof equipment dimensions, exact windows/bay spacing, floor heights, settlement amount and hidden passages.
No measured drawings were retrieved. Documentary floor area is not a footprint area and cannot validate a source polygon.
Dates and historical ownership of neighboring buildings are not inferred from this delivery.

privacy_and_rights.modeling_method: Original code, geometry and materials guided by observed architectural features; no photograph pixels or textures.
